reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but replacement copies unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting a reusable operation.

duplication.why: The diff duplicates the unlink field reset and the existing provider transaction-download workflow.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing account, sync, configuration and model layers, although a validation-named helper now also performs account detachment.

scope.why: All edits concern the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration or their tests.

maintainability.why: Shared linking and validation limit repetition, but duplicated cleanup and hidden mutation inside ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked bypasses unlinkAccount and reproduces its local cleanup; extracting that cleanup would allow reuse without provider removal.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadEnableBankingTransactions' token lookup, POST, error handling and response mapping into a more compact implementation.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: the shared linking guard gains replaceExistingLink and closed-target/replacement policy branches, expanding from validation into mutation; its replacement path duplicates unlinkAccount's local detachment.
